title: Anti-Wrinkle (Botox)
summary: Precision injections to relax facial muscles, smoothing fine lines and preventing the formation of deep wrinkles for a refreshed, youthful look.
description:
Our Anti-Wrinkle treatments use ultra-precise injections of botulinum toxin to temporarily relax the overactive facial muscles responsible for expression lines. The result is a naturally smooth, rested appearance that looks effortless — never frozen.

Our clinicians map your unique facial anatomy before every session, ensuring balanced, harmonious results tailored to your features.

title: Dermal Fillers
summary: Restore lost volume and enhance facial contours using premium hyaluronic acid fillers tailored to your unique anatomical structure.
description:
Dermal fillers use hyaluronic acid — a substance naturally found in the body — to restore facial volume, sculpt contours, and smooth deep folds. Whether enhancing lips, cheeks, jawline, or under-eye hollows, every treatment is mapped to your anatomy.

At Aser Clinic, we use only premium European fillers with a proven safety record, applied with cannula techniques to minimise bruising and maximise precision.

title: PRP Therapy
summary: Harness the healing power of your own blood platelets to stimulate collagen production and promote cellular skin rejuvenation naturally.
description:
Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy is a cutting-edge regenerative treatment that uses concentrated growth factors from your own blood to trigger natural collagen synthesis and skin renewal.

A small blood sample is spun in a centrifuge to isolate platelets, which are then re-injected or applied topically to target areas. Ideal for skin laxity, fine lines, hair loss, and overall glow restoration.

title: Skin Rejuvenation
summary: Advanced chemical peels and medical-grade microneedling treatments designed to improve skin texture, tone, and overall radiance.
description:
Our Skin Rejuvenation protocols combine clinical-strength chemical peels with precision microneedling to deliver transformative results. These treatments remove damaged surface layers, stimulate fibroblast activity, and dramatically improve texture, tone, and radiance.

Each protocol is custom-formulated after a thorough skin analysis — addressing pigmentation, acne scarring, enlarged pores, and dullness at every depth.

title: Laser Technology
summary: State-of-the-art laser systems for permanent hair reduction, vascular lesion treatment, and targeted pigment correction.
description:
Aser Clinic operates medical-grade laser platforms — including Nd:YAG, diode, and fractional CO₂ systems — to address a wide range of aesthetic concerns with unmatched precision.

From permanent hair reduction across all skin types to the targeted removal of vascular lesions, age spots, and melasma, our laser treatments are calibrated by experienced clinicians to deliver safe, effective outcomes with minimal discomfort.

title: Medical Skincare
summary: Bespoke skincare protocols featuring clinical-grade active ingredients to maintain and enhance your clinical results at home.
description:
Our Medical Skincare service goes beyond retail recommendations. After a thorough skin analysis, our clinicians design a bespoke daily protocol using pharmaceutical-grade actives — retinoids, peptides, growth factors, and prescription agents — to maintain and amplify your in-clinic results.

We partner with leading medical skincare brands and can compound custom formulations for your skin's specific needs.
